envelope.description: The daemon's search requests refuse a request that names a repository under index

body.title: The daemon's search requests refuse a request that names a repository under index
body.summary: src/daemon/index.ts: one guard helper resolves the repositories a request names (by repoPath, repoId, filePath, entityId's stored root path, or every one of rootIds) and, through ensureRepoQueryable's rule and wording, refuses with an error string starting 'repo-indexing: ' when any of them is under index. Applied to search.callers, search.callees, search.callers_nhop, search.by_file, search.closure, entity.summary, entity.closure, entity.unreachable, repo.depends_on, repo.search_cross_repo and locate.inferParents. Parameters and results are unchanged otherwise. Grounding (src/daemon/index.ts): search.closure :1060 {repoPath}; search.callers :1065, search.callees :1070, entity.summary :1102 and search.callers_nhop :1221 {entityId}; locate.inferParents :1081 {repoPath}; entity.closure :1107 and entity.unreachable :1123 {rootIds}; repo.depends_on :1184 and repo.search_cross_repo :1203 {repoId}; search.by_file :1216 {filePath}; search.query :1048 names none. Other daemon requests that read the graph are deliberately outside this guard, as the LLD scopes it to the search requests: repo.stats (src/daemon/index.ts:588, the status and counts read that must answer during an index), codeReview.grounding (:762, the code review's grounding), repo.entitiesForSourceRoots (src/daemon/source-roots-rpc.ts:21) and the analyze.* requests together with the analyze.run.start (:1870) and workflow.run (:1878) stream requests, which reach the graph only through the analyzer, whose own check refuses (t7-t10). The workflow-internal locate path (src/workflow/locate/infer-daemon.ts:65) calls resolveClosure itself and is likewise unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Each named request about a repository being indexed answers 'repo-indexing: ...' with the figures and no result; about another, ready repository it answers as before (the t11 contract test stays green).
entity.closure / entity.unreachable with any root in a repository under index are refused.
A registry read that throws skips the guard and the request is answered as today.

tests.name: search requests: search.callers / search.callees / search.by_file / search.closure / entity.summary / repo.depends_on / locate.inferParents about a repository being indexed answer 'repo-indexing: ...' with the figures and no result; about another, ready repository they answer as before
entity.closure / entity.unreachable with a root in a repository under index are refused
search guard: a registry read that throws skips the guard and the request is answered as today
